Jane Smith
Senior Full Stack Engineer
Email: jane.smith@example.com | Phone: (555) 019-2834 | San Francisco, CA

SUMMARY
Passionate Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable web applications, distributed systems, and AI-powered products. Proven track record in TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and Cloud infrastructure.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, SQL, HTML5, CSS3
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Fastify, GraphQL, REST APIs
- Databases & Search: PostgreSQL, Redis, Pinecone, FAISS, MongoDB
- Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, GCP, AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Terraform

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lead Engineer | TechCorp Inc. (2021 - Present)
- Architected and deployed high-throughput RAG pipeline handling 2M daily vector queries with sub-100ms latency.
- Led team of 6 engineers building enterprise AI documentation assistant using Gemini API and React.
- Reduced database response time by 45% by implementing Redis caching and indexing optimizations.

Software Engineer | InnovateSoft (2018 - 2021)
- Developed real-time collaborative dashboard using React, WebSocket, and Express.
- Built microservices in Node.js and Docker deployed on Google Cloud Run.

EDUCATION
B.S. in Computer Science | University of California, Berkeley (2014 - 2018)
Graduated with Honors, GPA 3.8/4.0

app engagement and learning outcomes

bm_01.question: What is the core architecture mechanism of Retrieval-Augmented Generation?
bm_01.expectedAnswer: RAG combines vector embedding retrieval over indexed document chunks with an LLM generation phase to ground answers in verified external knowledge.

bm_02.question: How does chunk overlap prevent context fragmentation?
bm_02.expectedAnswer: Chunk overlap preserves semantic context and entity relationships that cross chunk boundary boundaries so facts are not cut in half.

bm_03.question: What is the capital of Mars?
bm_03.expectedAnswer: I couldn't find enough information in the uploaded documents to answer this reliably.

bm_04.question: Why does hybrid search combine BM25 and vector embeddings?
bm_04.expectedAnswer: Hybrid search combines keyword precision (BM25 for exact terms, acronyms, IDs) with dense vector semantic understanding using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
